_how: Config + toy data of lesson 4.7 contextual (web/lessons/39_contextual.js). The examples/*/39_contextual.* files carry the same values; tests/contextual.test.js fails if they drift.
table = the static table (one row per word, made up by the author). Each case = one word with two senses and two sentences (sentences from NitMonk, content words only).

scoreDivisor sqrtDim: score = (e_word · e_j) / sqrt(d), the scaling of the usual attention formula; the author's toy has no W_q / W_k / W_v. tieEps = two senses whose cos differ by less are shown as a tie (both are 0.777 for static bank).

sentences.text: I deposited money in the bank
